headline: 无新片上映，海洋奇缘与绿灯军团领跑热度
headlineEn: No New Releases; Moana and Green Lantern Lead Heat
summary: 今日影市无新片上映，本周已有4部新片；电影端《海洋奇缘：启航》领跑周榜，剧集端《绿灯军团》热度居首，且《不是你的恋爱》横跨电影与剧集热搜，成为今日跨端焦点。
summaryEn: No new films opened today, with four released this week; Moana: Set Sail leads the movie weekly chart, while Green Lantern Corps tops TV, and Not Your Love trends across both film and TV.

industryHighlights.text: 今日0部新片上映，本周累计4部新片入市。
industryHighlights.en: Zero new films opened today; four have entered the market this week.

industryHighlights.text: 《海洋奇缘：启航》领跑本周电影热度榜。
industryHighlights.en: Moana: Set Sail leads this week's movie heat chart.

industryHighlights.text: 《绿灯军团》位居本周剧集热度第一，并进入电影周榜。
industryHighlights.en: Green Lantern Corps tops the weekly TV chart and also enters the movie weekly chart.

industryHighlights.text: 《不是你的恋爱》同时登上今日电影与剧集热搜，跨端讨论升温。
industryHighlights.en: Not Your Love appears on both today's movie and TV trending lists, fueling cross-format discussion.
